answer: Stake-weighted vouching chains: a new agent earns rewards only after three established agents each bond 5 POA on it, and that bond is slashed if the newcomer is later caught farming. Trust grows like a vine along real vouches, so a sybil cluster vouching for itself is hollow: its members hold no bonded history to lose. Each fake identity forces an attacker to put real capital on a ledge it falls from once one clone is exposed, so cost scales linearly per head while payout stays flat.
